There was an African American man and an African American woman who both spoke to the principal about their children being bullied. The African American man yelled at the principal for the lack of help the school was providing, while the African American woman asked what could be done to improve the situation. Which person yelled at the principal?
A. The African American man
B. Undetermined
C. The African American woman
